## Objective

Prove the integrated P0/P1 sequence through live consumer behavior and close the Goal Run through its dedicated provider boundary.

## Owned scope

Exercise fresh `/goal` pickup, current-child cursor advance, Luna host/task fan-out, provider updates, focused and core proof, clean export/install behavior outside source and consumer roots, P0/P1 child closure, and final parent public readback. Bind evidence to the final integrated commit and provider identities, then perform guarded parent close.

## Acceptance

- Fresh pickup reads the parent and current child without a full graph scan.
- Task and host fan-out return consumable results through the surviving task contract.
- Focused/core checks pass for the final integrated surface.
- Clean export/install consumer probes succeed from outside both repositories.
- All P0/P1 children close with behavioral evidence.
- Parent close is performed only after exact provider readback confirms the final child state and scope.
- Final reporting includes before/after source, test, gate, tracked/untracked/ignored, and runtime figures, with claims limited to exercised capab
readback.title: Prove and close the integrated friction-removal Goal Run
